summary: A 1963 R-6 flat cab on a 12-foot base in the Clearwater National Forest, on a site with a 1919 camp and an early 1919 wireless fire report.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab with catwalk on a 12-foot base

access.note: Listed as drive-up. The pages read do not state visiting rules.

events.note: A wireless telephone at the site was used to report a blaze to the forest ranger at Lolo Hot Springs; a Nevada State Journal item dated August 15, 1919 said it was reportedly the first such report in history
Log cabin with cupola built by the Forest Service; the register calls it the first lookout at the site
Current R-6 flat cab on a 12-foot base replaced the 1922 cabin; sources disagree on concrete versus cinder block base
Earliest staff year listed by Idaho Fire Lookouts
Most recent staff years listed as 2022 to 2024

evidence.supports: Clearwater National Forest, Idaho County location

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1919 camp and the 1922 log cabin came before the current R-6 cab; the register's 1963 date is for the current cab, so the sources' different build years refer to different structures on the same site.

notes_for_editor: Core dates agree (1922 cabin, 1963 current cab, 2009 registration), but the base is disputed: the register, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say concrete; the Forest Lookouts (weebly) page says cinder block. The record's height_m 3.7 and kind two_story are not supported by any page read and were left out of facts. No rental listing found in one search; access is only the drive-up note from Idaho Fire Lookouts (July 2025 article). The weebly page's 1919 material is attributed to a Nevada State Journal item it quotes; that original was not checked.
